title: Make scripts/ a proper installable package to eliminate sys.path hacks
description:
Several scripts use `sys.path.insert` to make `puppeteer` and `scripts` importable. This is unnecessary since both are workspace packages, but `schemas/` is not — it relies on namespace package resolution after a `sys.path.insert(0, REPO_ROOT)` call.

PR #923 removed most path hacks, but one remains in `schemas/migrations/v3_to_v4.py` (which does `sys.path.insert` to import from `puppeteer.harness_epoch`). The root `pyproject.toml` declares `packages = ["scripts"]` but not `schemas`, so `schemas` only works as an implicit namespace package when the repo root is on sys.path.

Fix: add `schemas` to the `packages` list in the root `pyproject.toml` (and add `schemas/__init__.py` if needed), then remove the remaining `sys.path.insert` in `v3_to_v4.py`. This ensures all cross-package imports work through the workspace without path manipulation.
